Five nonmatching-minus-matching rational differences have positive denominators and positive-coefficient numerators under m=3+x,n=4+x+y (coefficients 30,26,30,18,15); the two-row differences are positive for n≥3. Hence winners exactly three nonattacking rooks for 3≤m<n, count 6 C(m,3) C(n,3), and three distinct second-coordinates split 2+1 for m=2<n, count 6C(n,3), with rational minima displayed in pinned result. Independently inverted grounded Laplacians for every three-leader set on six small strictly rectangular graphs and obtained identical winner sets/counts. The proof supplies the all-m,n positive-polynomial certificate; grid alone would not.
